            <h1>Kubeflow MPI Operator</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Kubeflow MPI Operator</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Kubeflow MPI Operator supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/mpi-operator/components/mpi-job/icons/color/mpi-job-color.svg"
                        alt="mpi-job"
                        onerror="handleImageError(this)"
                        data-logo-for-dark="/content/en/extensions/models/mpi-operator/components/mpi-job/icons/white/mpi-job-white.svg"
                        data-logo-for-light="/content/en/extensions/models/mpi-operator/components/mpi-job/icons/color/mpi-job-color.svg" />
                </div>
                <p class="Compitems">mpi-job</p>
            </div>
            
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<article>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>NGINX</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for NGINX</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/nginx\/icons\/color\/nginx-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

            <h1>Ngrok Operator</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Ngrok Operator</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Ngrok Operator supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/ngrok-operator\/icons\/color\/ngrok-operator-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }
</script>

            <h1>Nirmata AWS Adapter</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Nirmata AWS Adapter</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Nirmata AWS Adapter supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Nirmata Venafi Adapter</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Nirmata Venafi Adapter</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Nirmata Venafi Adapter supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/nirmata-venafi-adapter/components/image-key/icons/color/image-key-color.svg"
                        alt="image-key"
                        onerror="handleImageError(this)"
                        data-logo-for-dark="/content/en/extensions/models/nirmata-venafi-adapter/components/image-key/icons/white/image-key-white.svg"
                        data-logo-for-light="/content/en/extensions/models/nirmata-venafi-adapter/components/image-key/icons/color/image-key-color.svg" />
                </div>
                <p class="Compitems">image-key</p>
            </div>
            
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Nocalhost</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Nocalhost</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Notary</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Notary</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for ondat-operator</p>
    
    
    <div>

                Components (2)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for ondat-operator supports the following components.</p>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/open-policy-agent-(opa)\/icons\/color\/open-policy-agent-(opa)-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<article>

            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for OpenELB supports the following components.</p>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>OpenFeature</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for OpenFeature</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>OpenGitOps</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for OpenGitOps</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>
